claims.exact_statement: For every finite d and positive dual Q on traceless Hermitian Hilbert-Schmidt space, the support of canonical POVM/prepare maps equals the maximum of integral f_Q(P)=sum_i w_i(Tr(P A_i))^2 over pure-state probability measures with barycenter I/d, and equals inf tau(Z) over Hermitian Z satisfying Tr(ZP)>=f_Q(P) for every rank-one P. Rank-one refinement gives the same support as all canonical POVM maps for positive Q, but the sets of maps are not equal; compactness of the full map set is represented by probability measures on density matrices with barycenter I/d.
assumptions: Q=sum_i w_i |A_i><A_i| with w_i>=0 and tau(A_i^2)=1

claims.exact_statement: For each finite d, the set of all canonical POVM/prepare maps is the continuous second-moment image of probability measures on the compact density-matrix space with barycenter I/d; it is compact and convex. Every image point has a finite-support representing measure by Caratheodory in combined barycenter and moment coordinates. Rank-one refinement PSD-dominates arbitrary canonical maps, so support maxima for Q>=0 and existence of a canonical dominator may be restricted to rank-one maps, although the full and rank-one map sets are not equal.
assumptions: canonical map prepares each normalized POVM effect
claims.status: internally proved compactness and finite-support representation; audit corrected earlier mistaken identification of full canonical maps with rank-one maps
claims.novelty_boundary: Compact measure representation, Caratheodory, and weighted Cauchy--Schwarz refinement are standard ingredients; no priority claim.
claims.costs: Existential finite-dimensional support bound depends on the dimension of the combined moment coordinate space; no efficient extraction or bit cost is claimed.
claims.falsifier: A canonical POVM moment lies outside the density-matrix measure image, the finite-support reduction fails, or rank-one refinement fails to PSD-dominate the original map.
